title: Central America
html:
Central America is a North American map in OpenFront covering the isthmus from the Yucatán peninsula down to Panama, with the Caribbean coast, the Mosquito Coast and the Pacific side of the region.

Nations

The map features 22 named nations, including Yucatan, Quintana Roo, Campeche, Guatemala, Belize, El Salvador, Honduras and Nicaragua, plus a pool of 41 additional coastal nations (Mexican, Guatemalan, Honduran, Nicaraguan, Costa Rican and Panamanian cities) that the game can draw on to fill larger lobbies.

Details

  • Categories: North America, New
  • Nations: 22 (+41 additional)
  • Public rotation frequency: 5
